# ToolForge ATS Resume Checker

> ToolForge is a free, 100% private in-browser ATS (Applicant Tracking System) resume scanner, keyword matcher, and bullet point optimizer. All document parsing and text analysis run client-side in browser memory with zero server uploads.

## Core Capabilities
- **Document Structure & Keyword Analysis**: Checks document formatting, font safety, table avoidance, section heading clarity, and contact info placement.
- **Job Description Keyword Matcher**: Compares candidate resumes against target job descriptions, identifying matching skills, missing keywords, and frequency gaps.
- **Google X-Y-Z Bullet Polisher**: Guides users in structuring achievements using Google's hiring formula: "Accomplished [X], as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]" with user-provided metrics.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Resumes are parsed locally in browser memory. Zero bytes of candidate resume text are sent to servers or third-party APIs.

## Key URLs
